doc.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Working with Harry Sweets Edison
summary: Praise for Sweets Edison as an individual and a legend.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Bix Beiderbecke: hearing, copying and remembering him

blocks.x: Well speaking of home movies, thank you for this video, which you got to play with Sweets. What was it like to work with him?

He’s a great guy, a really wonderful guy. And again, like I talked about Benny, he still, he’s getting up there in years but he still comes out to play, sounds great, he’s one of these people that when you hear a few notes you know it’s him. He’s an individual, he’s his own man, and he’s a legend. And thank God he’s still around and that he’ll play with somebody like me. I like him very much.
